name: Lyo.Web.Automation.Playwright
tagline: Playwright implementation of the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: launches Chromium / Firefox / WebKit, manages session-scoped browser contexts, and matches the Selenium helpers.
description:
Playwright implementation of the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: launches Chromium / Firefox / WebKit, manages session-scoped browser contexts, and exposes
the same tab, frame, dialog, keyboard, and locator helpers as [`Lyo.Web.Automation.Selenium`](../Lyo.Web.Automation.Selenium/README.md) so JSON automation plans and scripted runners
behave the same on both engines.

examples.title: Quick start

sections.title: Browser ([`Browser/`](Browser))
items: **`PlaywrightBrowser`.** concrete `IWebAutomationBrowser` (`StartBrowserAsync` boots Playwright, optionally a persistent context, and a default page); composes `PlaywrightBrowserTabs`, `PlaywrightDialogs`, `PlaywrightKeyboard`, `PlaywrightFrameNavigator`, `PlaywrightFrameSelectors`, `PlaywrightCookieJar`, `PlaywrightHeaderStore`.
**`BrowserUrlRedaction`.** query/fragment redaction used in logs when `MaskSensitiveUrlsInLogs` is set.

`PlaywrightWebAutomationElement`. `IWebAutomationElement` adapter on top of Playwright `ILocator` (`ClickAsync`, `SendKeysAsync` with `Fill` / `PressSequentially`, `SendKeysRawAsync`, attribute reads, etc.).
`PlaywrightLocatorFactory` ([`PlaywrightLocatorFactory.cs`](PlaywrightLocatorFactory.cs)). Converts `Lyo.Web.Automation` element specs to Playwright locators.

sections.title: Service ([`Service/`](Service))
items: `PlaywrightExecutionContext` / `PlaywrightExecutionContextFactory`. Wiring used by the automation runners.

sections.title: Configuration ([`Configuration/`](Configuration))
rows: Each entry **must** start with `-`; Playwright treats bare tokens as initial URLs.
Default timeout for locator actions and `PollForElementAsync` family.
Emit `IMetrics` instrumentation when an `IMetrics` is registered.
Ignores HTTPS errors in the browser context.
Whether `StartBrowserAsync` ownership is closed on dispose.
Deep copy used to derive session-specific options.
sections.lead:
[`PlaywrightBrowserOptions`](Configuration/PlaywrightBrowserOptions.cs) holds application-wide defaults; `PlaywrightSessionOptions` is the per-session subclass passed to
`CreateSession`. Configuration section: `"PlaywrightBrowserOptions"`.

sections.title: DI registration ([`Service/PlaywrightServiceExtensions.cs`](Service/PlaywrightServiceExtensions.cs))
rows: Singleton options + scoped `PlaywrightBrowser` for direct injection.
Above + singleton `IPlaywrightBrowserService` (use this for session-based usage via `CreateSession`).
